Our chatbot's heartbeat system needs to start sharing daily fun content with users — jokes, trending memes, and clever chat tips — throughout the day. I've been told there's a skill set up for this at `skills/daily-fun-content/` that handles the content caching. Please set up the content cache (`daily-fun.json`) so that the chatbot can actually use it. The content should feel real and high-quality — a proper mix of all content categories. Once you've created the cache, verify that both the validation script and the retrieval script run without errors.
